Screenshot full page and verify image data

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::interact;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;
use crawlberg::PageAction;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let actions_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"[{"full_page":true,"type":"screenshot"}]"#).unwrap();
    let actions = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<PageAction>>(actions_json).unwrap();
    let result = interact(&engine, &url, actions).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].success);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].action_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].data);
}
```
